title: Node.js
tagline: Understand JavaScript running beyond the browser
summary: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built around an event-driven, non-blocking architecture. This book takes you from the Node.js runtime model and modules through the event loop, asynchronous I/O, filesystem APIs, streams, buffers, HTTP, networking, processes, workers, databases, authentication, testing, CLI applications, package architecture, performance, security, observability, and production deployment. By the end you'll understand what Node.js is actually doing underneath your JavaScript and how to design reliable server-side systems with it.
